consequence.statement: Existing ClusterCleanupPolicy objects stay stored as v2beta1 until rewritten; a storage version migration and status.storedVersions update are needed before a later release removes v2beta1.
consequence.remediation: Re-write all ClusterCleanupPolicy objects (storage version migration) and update status.storedVersions of the CRD before upgrading to a release that removes v2beta1.

assertion.statement: The storage version of the clustercleanuppolicies.kyverno.io CRD changes from v2beta1 to v2 (1.12.6 → 1.13.0), so existing objects need storage migration before v2beta1 is removed.
